lookups.query: On a classic CPC, which cursor and light-pen registers can I read back on type 0 versus type 1, and what does reading dummy register 31 return on each?
lookups.note: Type 0 reads R12-R17, type 1 reads R14-R17 only; R10/R11 unreadable on both; dummy 31 is 0x00/0xFF.

lookups.query: I poll the type 1 status port while sweeping R6 — exactly when does bit 5 change, and does forcing border with R6=0 show up there?
lookups.note: Bit 5 sampled at C0=R0 from BORDER-R6 condition; R6=0-forced-while-C4>0 not reflected.

lookups.query: If I rewrite R7 to the current row address in the middle of a scanline on a type 0, when is the vertical sync blocked versus started late, and how does that stretch its length?
lookups.note: C0vs 0/1 blocked; C0vs>1 immediate start, C3h from next line, duration +(R0-C0vs).

lookups.query: How does the same mid-row R7 rewrite behave on a type 1 — does the partial line count toward the pulse, and which way does the duration move?
lookups.note: Fires at any C0, partial line counts as line 1, duration reduced by C0+1.

lookups.query: On a type 0, during which character times are R4 and R9 edits allowed to decide whether the current row is the frame's last line?
lookups.note: C0<2 evaluation window; R4/R9 writes there validate or clear Last Line.

lookups.query: I lower R9 below the live C9 outside adjustment, or R4 below C4 — does C9 wrap to zero or run to 31 first, and does C4 run to 127?
lookups.note: Equality only: C9 to 31, C4 to 127 then wrap; zero is not a wildcard.

lookups.query: What locks up when I program R0 to zero on a type 0, which counters stop, and which registers can I still change while frozen?
lookups.note: C0 pinned at 0, C9 frozen, R4/R5/R9 ignored, R8 live, HSYNC only if R2==0.

lookups.query: I set the horizontal displayed count higher than the line total — what thin seam shows up between rows on a type 0, and what does a type 1 show instead?
lookups.note: Type 0 one 0.5us border byte at C0=R0; type 1/3/4 nothing, rows merge.

lookups.query: When the horizontal match never arrives, how long after the line-total match is the border edge sent, and when does it turn off again on types 0 and 2?
lookups.note: BORDER 0.5us after C0=R0, disabled next character 0.5us later.

lookups.query: How do I shift the type 0 border transitions later by one or two character times, and does that shift the video-pointer latch too?
lookups.note: SKEW DISP +1/+2 delays visible edge only; VMA latch unaffected, immediate mid-line.

lookups.query: In interlaced video on a type 0, what parity condition appends the extra scanline after any adjustment lines?
lookups.note: R8 in {1,3} and ParityR6 odd; line holds C4=R4+1.

lookups.query: What is the simpler gate for that appended scanline on a type 1, and what does the following paragraph about C4 accounting not control?
lookups.note: R8 in {1,3} and ParityFrame even; C4/multiple wording does not gate existence.

lookups.query: How do the two frame-parity flags on a type 1 toggle at frame start and per row, and what happens to the line counter when I flip R8 mid-frame?
lookups.note: ParityFrame each frame at C4=C9=C0=0; ParityC9 per C4 if R9 even; R8 toggle rules p.209-210.

lookups.query: On a type 0, which internal parity flags exist, when does the row-end parity update fire for odd R9, and how is VSYNC nudged for odd rows?
lookups.note: ParityFrame/ParityR6/ParityC9; p.220 update ParityC9=C4.0 xor ParityFrame; odd-R7 VSYNC delay-by-1.

lookups.query: During interlace, on which horizontal half-line does the mid-frame vertical sync fire on even frames?
lookups.note: MID-VSYNC on even frame at C4=R7 and C0=R0/2.

lookups.query: Once interlace is on for a type 0, how is the line counter doubled with parity for the address, and how do entry, steady and exit rows test their limits?
lookups.note: Split C9/C9.VMA (C9x2|parity); switch R9|ParityFrame, steady R9|ParityC9, exit plain R9.

lookups.query: What is the two-stage line-count recipe on a type 1 in interlace, and how does the parity flag move when R9 is even?
lookups.note: C9=C9+not(R9.0); masked C9/R9 test manages C4; ParityC9 toggles if R9 even.

lookups.query: If I poke new display-start values during the first character row on a type 1, on which character edges do they actually reach the video pointer?
lookups.note: VMA reloaded every C0=0 while C4=0 regardless of C9; catches same-edge write.

lookups.query: What exact write to the adjustment-total register arms the easy type 1 rupture, and which two behaviours does it switch on?
lookups.note: R5 0->nonzero at C0=R0; VMA-source every row + frame-parity-dependent C9 test.

lookups.query: Once that rupture is armed, why does one frame repeat characters while the next does not, and what flips that every frame when R9 is odd?
lookups.note: Case1 C9=R9 faulty at C0=R1 so VMA' not updated; case2 clean; parity flips at C4=C9=C0=0 with R9 odd.

lookups.query: During vertical adjustment on a type 1, which counter tallies the extra lines while the row and line counters keep cycling for the video address?
lookups.note: Separate C5 counts adjustment; C9 cycles 0..R9 (RA from C9), C4 increments at wraps; type 0 has no C5.

lookups.query: I clear the adjustment total mid-adjustment on a type 1 — does the adjustment end, and what keeps looping?
lookups.note: State not deactivated, C4 not reset, C5 loops until reachable positive R5.

lookups.query: If I shrink R3l below the live C3l mid-HSYNC, when does C3l wrap versus cut the pulse immediately, and why does type 1 with zero behave differently?
lookups.note: Lower R3l below C3l wraps except type 1 zero cancels immediately.

lookups.query: How can a small R0/R2/R3 combo lock horizontal sync on forever, and how does a type 0 escape it where other types do not?
lookups.note: R0=0 R2=0 R3=1 re-triggers every char on types 1/2/3/4; type 0 skips 2nd char.

lookups.query: On a type 0 stuck in that endless sync, what does rewriting R3 exactly at the terminal count do to the low sync counter?
lookups.note: Exact-end R3 change at C0=R2+R3 makes C3l overflow; earliest ~3.5px restart.

lookups.query: What stops a second vertical sync from firing right after one, and how does the type 2 ghost differ from the type 0 blocked state?
lookups.note: VSYNC protection mechanism 2; blocked consumes C4=R7 without pin; ghost counts without pin during HSYNC.

lookups.query: How many lines does VSYNC last via R3h on type 0 versus type 1, and what does R3h=0 mean on each?
lookups.note: R3h lines; type 0 0->16 via wrap, type 1 fixed 16.

lookups.query: When R1 fits inside R0, which C0=R1 and C0=0 matches turn border off and on, and what latches VMA prime to VMA at the C9=R9 row end?
lookups.note: BORDER off at C0=0, on at C0=R1; VMA'/VMA row-end latch at C9=R9/C0=R1.

lookups.query: If I zero the vertical displayed total exactly on the first row, when does the border become definitive, and does a brief earlier zero count?
lookups.note: Definitive at C0=R1 only if R6 still zero then; earlier zero since cleared does not stick (FR).

lookups.query: How can I tell the CRTC type by sweeping the vertical sync row past the row-total overflow, and where does the type 1 pulse quit?
lookups.note: R4=36 R9=7 R5=16 sweep R7=38/39; type1 VSYNC stops past 39, overrun repeats per §28.1.1.

claims.claim: R10 and R11 return zero when read on CRTC types 0 and 1; only types 3 and 4 expose them as readable status registers.
claims.label: supports
claims.note: Direct table: type 1 reads R14-R17 only; R10/R11 not readable on 0/1.

claims.claim: On type 1, status bit 5 follows the R6-border condition sampled at C0=R0, and forcing border with R6=0 while C4 is nonzero does not set it.
claims.label: supports
claims.note: All three F2 nuances verbatim at §21.3.3 p.248.

claims.claim: On type 0, writing R7 equal to C4 at C0 0 or 1 blocks VSYNC with no pulse, while a later mid-line write starts it immediately and stretches total length.
claims.label: supports
claims.note: Blocked at C0vs<2, duration +(R0-C0vs), counter from next C0=0.

claims.claim: During type 1 vertical adjustment a dedicated C5 tallies extra lines while C9 keeps cycling 0..R9 and C4 advances at each wrap, so the video address keeps cycling.
claims.label: supports
claims.note: C5/C9 dissociated on 1/2; type 0 has no C5.

claims.claim: With R1 greater than R0, type 0 inserts a single half-microsecond border byte at C0=R0 before the next line, while type 1 inserts nothing.
claims.label: supports
claims.note: 0.5us byte, BORDER OFF next char, any R0 incl 0 alternation.

claims.claim: On type 1 every frame start copies the frame parity into the line parity flag, so an odd interlaced frame restarts its line counter at one.
claims.label: supports
claims.note: Author-confirmed ParityC9=ParityFrame at frame start; IA-2 t32a.

claims.claim: Freezing R0 at zero for N character times costs about N divided by R9-plus-one character rows.
claims.label: contradicts
claims.note: Digest B2 (findings-review.md:55) misstates wall-clock cost; source §13.2 p.105 says N/64 raster lines (64x8us forgets 8 lines).

claims.claim: With R0 set to one and R5 left at zero, each two-microsecond frame chains into another adjustment frame until the adjustment counter reaches R5.
claims.label: contradicts
claims.note: Digest B3 (findings-review.md:60) wrong; source §13.2.5 stops after 1 line when C9==R5 then strictly alternates normal/additional.

claims.claim: The R8 skew-select field lives at bits 4:3 for the delay and bits 6:5 for the mode, with the border-on mask at bits 3:2.
claims.label: contradicts
claims.note: Digest B8 (findings-review.md:79) bullets inverted; source §19.1 table Sc 7:6 Sd 5:4, BORDER ON 001100xx sets 5,4.

claims.claim: An even R9 setting yields an odd total line count per character in interlace, so R9=6 gives an odd number of lines.
claims.label: contradicts
claims.note: Digest B10 (findings-review.md:87) inverted; source §19.5.2 even R9 gives even total (R9=6 -> 2x4=8).

claims.claim: Definitive border at C0=R1 only needs R6 to have been zero at least once earlier in the frame, even if it was changed to nonzero before the match.
claims.label: contradicts
claims.note: BL-036 (differences:126): French requires R6 still zero at C0=R1; English at-least-once is the mistranslation.

claims.claim: Type 1 reloads its video pointer from R12/R13 on every return of C0 to zero while C4 is zero, regardless of C9.
claims.label: silent
claims.note: True per §20.3.2 p.243; §14.5 covers R3/HSYNC width only and never mentions VMA/R12/R13.

claims.claim: Lowering R3 below the live HSYNC counter wraps it, except that zero on type 1 cancels the pulse immediately.
claims.label: silent
claims.note: True per §14.5; §11.6 covers RFD/VMA/parity only and never mentions R3/C3l/HSYNC width.

claims.claim: A type 0 R7 write at C0 0 or 1 is blocked with no pulse until C4 or R7 changes value.
claims.label: silent
claims.note: True per §16.4.1; §17.6.2 covers R1>R0 border byte only and never mentions VSYNC/R7/blocked.

claims.claim: Registers R10 and R11 read as zero on types 0 and 1.
claims.label: silent
claims.note: True per §21.2.2; §19.5.3 covers type-1 parity only and never mentions readback/R10/R11.

claims.claim: Status bit 5 on type 1 is sampled from the border condition only at C0=R0.
claims.label: silent
claims.note: True per §21.3.3; §10.3 covers C9 counting rules only and never mentions status/bit 5.
